items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: the saxophone player who, from the 20s was in the Paul Whiteman band

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s very curious that you say that because I don’t know if you put that in my head in reading some of the material about you but I could hear that in your time.

You know you nailed it because let me tell you something. Everything I’ve done in my life, and I have a pretty wide scope of music from Louis to Charlie Parker, Miles — it all, the foundation of all of it is Louis’ time. And not just for me. I heard an interview from a documentary of Bing Crosby. And Bing said me, I wouldn’t be here and Sinatra wouldn’t be here if it wasn’t for Louis. And I did a gig with, oh my God, the saxophone player who, from the 20s was in the Paul Whiteman band, you would know him, he was…
